rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for confiding personal worries or private matters in someone.

example.english: I often confide in my mother and can tell her all my worries.
example.traditional: 我成日同阿媽傾心事，乜嘢煩惱都敢講。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 aa3 maa1 king1 sam1 si6 mat1 je5 faan4 nou5 dou1 gam2 gong2

rows.note: Use this when the thing being confided is explicitly a secret rather than mainly feelings or worries.

example.english: I only confide a secret in you, so don't tell anyone.
example.traditional: 我淨係同你講秘密，你唔好同人講呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 tung4 nei5 gong2 bei3 mat6 nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2 aa3
